answer.thought: The body has been a tyrant today, demanding fuel with the indifference of a law. I have walked thirteen kilometres and eaten dhaba rice three times; the spirit is exhausted by the sheer physicality of survival. I must sleep before the mind begins to argue with itself in the dark. The air is cool now, a rare mercy in this city.
